title: Nvidia invests in Cursor maker Anysphere

sources.quote: We’re excited to deepen our work with existing investors, including Accel, Thrive, and Andreessen Horowitz, and welcome new partners Coatue, NVIDIA, and Google.

explain: Nvidia joined Anysphere's Series D as a new investor, amount not disclosed. Anysphere makes the Cursor AI coding app and was later bought by SpaceX.
